recipes.name: Grapefruit Rosemary Spritzer
instructions: Start with zesting the grapefruit. Reserve the zest for later.
Add the juice from the same grapefruit to a saucepan, along with the remaining syrup ingredients. Cook uncovered at a gentle simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Stir often.
Then add the grapefruit zest to the saucepan. Use a wooden spoon or tamper to mash the pieces of pineapple to release their juices and flavours.
Place a sieve over a bowl or pitcher and strain the mixture. Use the back of a spoon to press out as much liquid as possible. Let cool completely.
Divide the ice between the glasses. To each cup, add 1 part syrup, 1 part grapefruit juice, 2 parts carbonated water. Garnish and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage The drink is best enjoyed immediately. The simple syrup can be made ahead and stored in a glass jar in the fridge for up to 3 days.
